rules.layer: A member's retail layer is read from the addresses its overlay targets and definitions cite (the ledger namespace of functions.md, else the namespace both named neighbours agree on) and from the words its shape-map path binds (layout.tsv's declaring layer). The entity chain and the base's support objects (motor, navigator, hints, sounds, squad) sit at or below the base. The address-derived layer is an identity column; the disposition is reviewed.
rules.base_set: The base set is the largest set grown from the base anchors along references in which no member reaches Troika state: a Troika-anchored member, a Troika component word, or the senses runner. A base member may call a virtual the base declares (the body may be Troika's). A member that would reach Troika state leaves the set and stays on FElysiumNpc (stay:transitional), cascading to its base callers, unless the review records the retail path.
rules.plus_0x98: Retail base bodies reach the Troika object through CBaseEntity +0x98 m_pBaseNPCTroika, which is null on a non-Troika entity; the port's AsNpc() is that word. A base body keeps such an arm as `if (FElysiumNpc* Troika = AsNpc())` with the recovered call, never a cast. +0x94 m_pBaseNPC is AsNpcBase() (new).
rules.rename: A Base* helper whose parameters match the slot virtual's becomes the base's own body of that virtual (rename:<Slot>); the Troika body's direct call becomes FElysiumNpcBase::<Slot>(). A const difference adopts the virtual's signature. A mismatch keeps the helper's name on the base (BaseOnLooked).
rules.pair: A hand virtual whose one port body stands for both a base and a Troika slot body is split: the base half becomes FElysiumNpcBase::<Name>, the Troika half an override that calls it where retail does.
rules.collapse: A duplicate port body of one retail function folds into the surviving member on the base; its tests move to the survivor.
rules.components: ScheduleHost's base words move to FElysiumNpcBase::BaseScheduleHost (FElysiumNpcBaseScheduleHost), its Troika and Troika-read port words stay (field-decisions.tsv). Senses.Memory's base words move to FElysiumNpcBase::BaseMemory (FElysiumNpcBaseMemory, with its own Reset/Serialize/Rebase); Senses' three base words (PendingSounds +0x1ae0, HeardConditions +0x5ca8, bKeepSound +0x5cd8) become FElysiumNpcBase members. The senses object itself stays on FElysiumNpc (transitional; see transitional.Senses). Cognition, Schedule, Mind, NpcFlags and EnemyMemory hold only base words and move whole.
rules.senses_accessor: FElysiumNpcBase declares SensesObject(), the m_pSenses +0x5cdc accessor: null on the base (a base-only NPC's CAI_Senses is unported until fold 9), the Troika's Senses on FElysiumNpc. SetDistLook 0x1026a2a0 and BestEnemyCandidateVisible reach the object through it.
rules.chain: FloatSoundFrequency / NextFloatSoundTime (CBaseCombatCharacter +0x10e8/+0x10ec) move to FElysiumCombatCharacter (field-decisions.tsv). Other entity-chain words and bodies FElysiumNpc hosts move to the base, the nearest existing owner at or below their retail class; step 6 relocates them up the chain.
rules.deferred: Controller-line and maker rows stay on FElysiumNpc (their final base is below Troika). TestHull and cine compatibility arms move with their base-layer bodies and stay on the compatibility list (steps 9-10).
rules.name_hazard: FElysiumNpcBase is a prefix of FElysiumNpcBaseBoss: every codemod and checker match uses word boundaries.
